filter.mechanism: WP core resolves block.json selectors.filter.duotone DIRECTLY (wp_get_block_css_selector() -> WP_Duotone::get_selector()) — duotone has never been an inline-style support; WP_Duotone::render_duotone_support() always emits a scoped <style> block via wp_footer, independent of __experimentalSkipSerialization. Declared here as '.sgs-gallery__img', a non-root inner selector — already correctly routed, no render.php involvement needed.
